text: A paste-in prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf installs Bento's Agent Skills and gives the agent the full integration playbook
quote: Paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf. It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook

text: Each coding tool installs the skill the same way and then loads Bento's docs over MCP
quote: Each tool installs the skill the same way, then loads the docs over MCP.

text: Captures every span from any framework over OpenTelemetry, with a span tree view and links from a signal to the call that broke
quote: Every span from every framework, captured over OpenTelemetry. Open the span tree, or follow a signal straight to the call that broke.

text: Describe a failure mode in plain English and Bento trains a detector on your traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your history
quote: Describe any failure mode in plain English — Bento trains a signal on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your entire history

text: Recurring failures are grouped into tracked issues with status, severity, and the runs behind each one, for triage
quote: Bento groups recurring failures into tracked issues, the front door for triage, with status, severity, and the runs behind each one.

text: Similar findings are automatically grouped into clusters so patterns surface without manual searching
quote: Similar findings group into clusters, so patterns surface before you go looking.

text: Alerts written in English; fires are grouped into incidents and each is judged real or benign to cut noise
quote: Write alerts in English. Bento groups fires into incidents and judges each one real or benign — so you only wake up for real drift.

text: Alert rules compile to trace queries and route notifications to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook
quote: Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook.

text: Detects when an agent starts behaving differently and pinpoints exactly what shifted
quote: See when your agent starts behaving differently — Bento pinpoints exactly what shifted.

text: Built-in views of cost per run, tool failure rates, drift across prompt versions, and regressions across deploys
quote: you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.

text: Reusable trigger-based fixes (skills, subagents, tools) move from candidate to promoted as they prove themselves in production
quote: Reusable, trigger-based fixes: skills, subagents, and tools that graduate from candidate to promote as they prove themselves in production.

text: Fixes ship in shadow mode, are scored against the outcome they target, and go to 100% traffic only if they provably help
quote: The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.

text: Keeps a plain-language memory of the agent's failure patterns, fixes, and outcomes
quote: A living memory of what your agent has learned — every failure pattern, fix, and outcome, in plain language.

text: Every release is scored against production history offline, in CI, and on live traffic to catch regressions before users do
quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic. Catches regressions before users do.

text: Prompt, skill, and model changes are versioned, diffable, and reversible, and regressions can be traced to the causing change
quote: Every prompt, skill, and model change is versioned, diffable, and reversible. Trace any regression back to the change that caused it.

text: Skills and rules live in your repo as model-agnostic Markdown and YAML, so knowledge carries over when you upgrade models
quote: Skills and rules live in your repo as Markdown and YAML. They're model-agnostic, so when you upgrade your model, your accumulated knowledge transfers automatically.

text: Captures every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app automatically via an install extra
quote: Capture every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app with one line.

text: Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai to send manual events for SDKs without an integration
quote: Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai. Manual events for SDKs without an integration.

text: Framework-agnostic: any agent that takes a task and returns a result can be wrapped
quote: Yes. Bento is framework-agnostic. ... If your agent takes a task and returns a result, Bento can wrap it.

text: Can plug directly into an existing OpenTelemetry pipeline and skip the analytics layer
quote: Wire it into an OpenTelemetry pipeline directly when you already have one configured, and skip the analytics layer entirely.

text: Traces arrive by pointing an OTel exporter at one endpoint with one auth header; TypeScript needs no Bento package
quote: point its exporter at one endpoint with one auth header and the traces land in Bento. In TypeScript you can do this with no Bento package at all.

text: Spans can be tagged with experiment IDs, feature flags, or any custom metadata
quote: Tag spans with experiment IDs, feature flags, anything.

text: init() accepts user_id, session_id, and tags that are applied to every span
quote: `init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id`, and `tags` kwargs. Bento invokes them on every span

text: Passing the same convo_id on each call ties runs together into one conversation
quote: pass the same `convo_id` on every call and Bento ties the runs together for you.

text: Supports short-lived scripts and Lambdas by flushing buffered data with bento.flush() before exit
quote: Short-lived script or Lambda | Call `bento.flush()` before exit.

text: Agent-driven Langfuse migration finds call sites, installs Bento, translates constructs, verifies traces, then removes Langfuse
quote: it finds your Langfuse call sites, installs Bento alongside, translates each construct, verifies traces land, then removes Langfuse.

text: Captures every LLM call at the SDK level, so existing call sites don't change
quote: Your call sites stay untouched, since Bento captures every LLM call at the SDK level.

text: Provides a mechanical translation guide for migrating from Raindrop (raindrop-ai) to Bento
quote: From Raindrop: Mechanical translation from Raindrop (raindrop-ai) to Bento.

text: Instrumenting takes no rewrites, using the OpenTelemetry SDK, and Bento can run alongside an existing observability stack
quote: No rewrites. Drop in the OpenTelemetry SDK and you're instrumented. ... you can run Bento alongside your existing observability stack.

text: The CLI can do anything the dashboard can from a terminal, script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics
quote: Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.

text: CLI login opens the browser and saves tokens to the OS keychain
quote: bentolabs auth login          # opens the browser, saves tokens to the keychain

text: CLI supports raw JSON output to stdout that can be piped into jq, grep, or files
quote: `raw` | Plain JSON to stdout. Pipe into `jq`, `grep`, or a file.

text: Running bentolabs refresh pulls newly added commands into the CLI
quote: Run `bentolabs refresh` to pull in newly added commands.

text: CLI lists signals with filters by source, status, or group
quote: `signals list` | List signals. Filter by source, status, or group.

text: CLI reads signal events and firings, defaulting to the last 30 days with a configurable start time
quote: Read the events, the firings. This defaults to the last 30 days; widen it with `--start-time`

text: CLI can edit a signal's name, prompt, or config by sending only the changed fields
quote: `signals update <signal-id>` | Edit a signal's name, prompt, or config.
